source.title: The Ancient Items at the Library: Magical Bowls of Babylonian Jewry
source.citation: National Library of Israel, “The Ancient Items at the Library: Magical Bowls of Babylonian Jewry.” Accessed 4 September 2026.
source.notes: The article states that Avigdor Klagsbald donated seven distinct incantation bowls. Their stable NLI manuscript identifiers are not exposed on the article page and may overlap the separately harvested SRU records.

summary: One of seven incantation bowls donated to the National Library of Israel by Avigdor Klagsbald; exact mapping to NLI catalogue records remains unresolved.
